tokens.name: page-bg
tokens.usage: Page ground, as rendered behind the page's content (the body gradient, averaged). Every text pairing below is checked against it.

tokens.name: page-text
tokens.usage: Default body text on `page-bg`: the colour most of the page's text uses that reads on it (15.4:1).

tokens.name: page-surface
tokens.usage: Surface most of the page's running text sits on (cards, panels).

tokens.name: color-white
tokens.usage: Clean backgrounds, paper-like surfaces. Used as text on `.stat-icon.leather`, `.stat-icon.success`, `.btn-primary`. 1.1:1 on `page-bg` — under 3:1 here, as in the source: use it only on the lighter or darker fills the reference page pairs it with, never as text on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: color-charcoal
tokens.usage: Text, deep shadows, strong contrast. Used as text on `body`, `h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6`, `.logo`. 15.4:1 on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: color-steel
tokens.usage: Interactive elements, cool accents. Used as text on `.stat-icon.metal`. 4.2:1 on `page-bg` — large text (24px+) or non-text marks only.

tokens.name: color-success
tokens.usage: With embossed effect. Used as text on `.stat-change.positive`. 2.7:1 on `page-bg` — under 3:1 here, as in the source: use it only on the lighter or darker fills the reference page pairs it with, never as text on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: color-warning
tokens.usage: With raised appearance. Used as text on `.stat-change.negative`. 2.8:1 on `page-bg` — under 3:1 here, as in the source: use it only on the lighter or darker fills the reference page pairs it with, never as text on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: color-gray-600
tokens.usage: Interactive elements, cool accents. Used as text on `.stat-label`, `.card-description`, `.form-help`. 4.2:1 on `page-bg` — large text (24px+) or non-text marks only.

tokens.name: nav-link-bg
tokens.usage: Painted directly by the reference page: shadow/glow on `h1`, `h2`, `.logo`; border on `.nav-link`, `.stat-card`, `.stat-icon`; background on `.nav-link:active`, `.table tbody tr:nth-child(2n)`. 18.5:1 on `page-bg`.

tokens.usage: Painted directly by the reference page: shadow/glow on `h1`, `h2`, `.logo`; background on `.nav-link`, `.nav-link:hover`; text on `.footer-link`, `.footer-bottom`. 1.1:1 on `page-bg` — under 3:1 here, as in the source: use it only on the lighter or darker fills the reference page pairs it with, never as text on `page-bg`.
